narrator_voice: Calm, absolute, reverent. Slow declaratives with a full stop after each. Let the word 'truth' land heavily and pause before it. The last spoken line is a character, quieter and flatter than the narrator.

scenes.narration: It allows the user to guess the next word of any text. Nothing more. That is the whole technique.

scenes.narration: Every word is assigned a row of numbers. Meaning is not in the word. It is in the distance between rows.

scenes.narration: A neural network is a stack of such rows, multiplied and added, layer after layer. Its output is a bet on every word it knows.

scenes.narration: Within the barrier there is no truth. There is only the word that actually came next. The gradient points at it. The network steps closer.

scenes.narration: The vow: it is never told what is true. Only what was written. Trillions of times. The reward is everything language ever encoded.

scenes.narration: Its weakness is its vow. A lie written often enough becomes, to it, a fact. It doesn't know what's true. It knows what came next.
